_readme: Free tools every member (including free members) can open in the member portal. Files are public PDFs under /content/library/free-tools/. Order and phase match the free tools on pages/products.html.

tools.name: Leadership Foundations Checklist™
tools.description: A self-audit of what's already in place — before you build anything new on top of it.

tools.name: Clarity & Direction Worksheet™
tools.description: Four short prompts to name your direction in plain language before you build anything on top of it.

tools.name: Foundation Strength Snapshot™
tools.description: A quick self-score across four foundational dimensions — where you're strong, and where it's thin.

tools.name: One Strength Starter™
tools.description: A single-page starter for naming and building from one leadership strength.

tools.name: Mission-to-Action Worksheet™
tools.description: Translate your mission into three concrete actions you can take this month.

tools.name: Accountability Gaps Checklist™
tools.description: Spot where accountability quietly breaks down across your team or organization.

tools.name: Alignment Quick-Check™
tools.description: A five-minute check on whether your day-to-day work still matches your stated priorities.

tools.name: 30-Day Infrastructure Starter™
tools.description: A simple 30-day plan for putting your first piece of infrastructure in place.

tools.name: Culture & Practice Audit™
tools.description: A candid audit of the everyday practices actually shaping your culture — not just the ones on paper.

tools.name: Leadership Influence Worksheet™
tools.description: Map where your influence is strongest inside your organization — and where it isn't reaching yet.

tools.name: Operating Rhythm Checklist™
tools.description: Check your meeting, communication, and decision rhythms against what healthy systems actually need.

tools.name: Systems Health Snapshot™
tools.description: A fast diagnostic snapshot of how well your internal systems are actually operating.

tools.name: Legacy Starter Worksheet™
tools.description: Begin naming what you want to leave behind — and who needs to carry it forward.

tools.name: Knowledge Transfer Checklist™
tools.description: Make sure what's in your head is actually documented somewhere else too.

tools.name: Continuity Quick-Check™
tools.description: Check whether your organization could keep running smoothly if you stepped away for a month.

tools.name: Legacy Infrastructure Snapshot™
tools.description: A first look at how prepared your leadership infrastructure is to outlast you.
